name: sage-control-plane-benchmark
description: A benchmark for evaluating models' ability to generate, validate, and reason about control-plane actions and orchestration commands for cloud/infrastructure management. It measures correctness, robustness, and the ability to produce executable control-plane code or API calls under varied scenarios and constraints. The tasks emphasize safe, reliable command generation and handling of API semantics.
reputation: A niche dataset targeted at practitioners building LLM-driven automation for control-plane tasks; limited public adoption.
